<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/organizations/{organizationId}/users/{userId}"}

</MethodEndpoint>



Returns one credential, including its current password in clear text, a ready-made connection string and the SSH public keys attached to it. Handle the response as a secret.

Use `PasswordCreatedAt` to find credentials that are due for rotation.
